cases.expected: format.format(...) is called with the Set of ValidationMessage returned by JsonSchema.validate(executionContext, node). The returned value of format.format is propagated as the method result.

cases.expected: Both format.customize and executionCustomizer.customize are invoked exactly once. The result of format.format is returned.

cases.expected: Both format.customize and executionCustomizer.customize are called before the validation throws FailFastAssertionException. The caught messages are forwarded to format.format, and its return value is produced.
cases.description: Combine a non‑null customizer with a validation that fails fast; ensures the customizer is still executed before the exception is caught and handled.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when format.customize is invoked with a null ExecutionContext. No validation or format.format calls are performed.
cases.description: Verify that passing a null ExecutionContext causes the method to fail early with NPE during format.customize.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown because format is null before any method calls. The method should not attempt to call format.customize or format.format.
cases.description: Ensure that a null OutputFormat leads to an immediate NPE, protecting against dereferencing a null reference.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when the internal validate(executionContext, node) method receives a null JsonNode. format.format is never called.
cases.description: Validate that a null JsonNode argument is not tolerated and results in an NPE from the core validation routine.

cases.expected: RuntimeException thrown by executionCustomizer.customize propagates out of validate method. format.format is never invoked.

cases.expected: RuntimeException thrown by format.customize propagates out of validate method. No validation or format.format call occurs.
cases.description: When the OutputFormat's customize method throws an exception, the method must forward that exception; internal validation must not be performed.

cases.expected: RuntimeException thrown by format.format propagates out of validate method after successful validation. The exception is not caught inside the method.
cases.description: If format.format throws an exception after validation succeeds, the method should let the exception escape, preserving the original error context.

cases.expected: format.format(this, null, executionContext, validationContext) is called and its return value is propagated.

cases.expected: NullPointerException is thrown when format.customize attempts to access the JsonSchema's validationContext which is null. No further calls (customizer, internal validate, format.format) are performed.
